summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate). Changes: added Update container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns Update, building the prologue from the single declaration group before the empty-request early exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviours. Nothing was executed (tests, scripts, installs were not run per instructions), so all changes are verified by reading only. One unverified assumption: that INSERT ... WHERE {} with initBindings yields the binding in the Modify test. No commits were made.
